Ran Google Ads search and performance max campaigns, continually optimizing keywords, bids and creatives to lower CAC by 22% while scaling high-intent traffic. Used Google Analytics to analyze user cohorts and landing page behavior, feeding insights into SEO-led content updates that improved organic landing visits for priority funnels. Supported lead management using HubSpot, aligning campaign tagging with CRM to improve attribution accuracy and campaign ROI reporting. Maintained campaign runbooks and post-mortems in Confluence.
